text: Hello, boys and girls.I'm Julian.Nice to see you again.Are you ready for the class?Good.Before the class, please go and get four pieces of paper and the glue.Welcome back.In this class, we'll have an assessment too.If you do well in speaking, reading and writing, you can get five stars.First, read with Kitty.Hello, I'm a pupil.There are a lot of nice places in our school.We can study and play there.I like Rainbow Wonderland.It is a nice place.Let's go and have a look.Can you read the words?CanPlaceWeLetInNiceHelloLotPupilStudyHere are more words.Here are more words.Pay attention.Letter A in can and apple is pronounced as eh.Letter A in place and cake is pronounced as ay.What about E, I, O and U?Read and classify by yourselves.Let's check.WeSheE is pronounced as e here.LetDeskEEhInBigIINiceKiteIIHelloOpenOOLotBoxOAPupilStudentYouYouStudyUmbrellaYouAWell done.Henry and Kitty are playing with their toys in Rainbow Wonderland.Kitty, I like Rainbow Wonderland.We can play here.I like it too.It's a nice place.There are many insects, farm animals and plants here.Can you find them?I can see the trees and the flowers.How nice.In Rainbow Wonderland, there are many insects, farm animals and plants.What plants does Henry see?Yes, he sees some trees and flowers.What else can he see?Go and get your paper and pencils ready.Look and complete by yourselves.What insects can Henry see?A lady bird, ants, butterflies, bees.What farm animals can he see?Pigs, chicks, hens and ducks.So there are some bees, ants, butterflies, a lady bird, pigs, ducks, chicks and hens in Rainbow Wonderland.Henry and Kitty are talking about them.What are they talking?Ask an answer by yourselves.Look, what are they?They are hens.What color are they?How many hens?Two hens.What are they?And how many ants?Three ants.Wow, there are so many nice insects, farm animals and plants in Rainbow Wonderland.Look, I make a booklet about what I like in Rainbow Wonderland.Kitty makes a booklet about them.Look, this is Kitty's booklet.Let's take a quick look at it.What is it about?So it's about a lady bird, three ducks and a tree.There are more details on her booklet.Please read carefully and try to complete.So look at the lady bird.What color is it?How is it?Excellent.What does it have?Very good.What can it do?It can fly.What color are the ducks?White.How are they?And what can they do?They can swim.What color is the tree?Yes, it has a trunk, branches, roots and leaves.So you can describe what you like in Rainbow Wonderland from the aspects such as name, color, feature, parts or ability.Can you choose and say by yourselves?Well done.Henry sees many other nice things in Rainbow Wonderland.What does he see?Try to say by yourself.It's really a nice place.Amazing.Then how do you make your booklet, Kitty?Henry wants to make his booklet too.First, get three pieces of paper.Fold them.Stick them together with the glue.Take out three pieces of paper and your glue.Do what Kitty tells you.What's next?Next, I make the cover.I name it What's in Rainbow Wonderland.I write my name and draw or stick some pictures too.Is it nice?Can you make the cover for your booklet?Then look, I open the booklet.Draw or stick some pictures here and write here.This is the body part of your writing.This is the beginning.And the ending.You need to write about one insect, one kind of farm animals and one plant that you like in Rainbow Wonderland.But in today's class, you can just choose one and write.Get your pencils ready, go.Time is limited.You can finish the rest two on page three and four, five and six after class.Look, this is Henry's booklet.Please look and read by yourselves.Henry is happy to make such a nice booklet.Wow, I can learn about the natural world in Rainbow Wonderland.I like my new school.Do you like your school?This is my school.There are many nice places in it.The library, the classrooms, the studio, the playground and so on.And we can learn about the natural world in our school too.Look, this is the garden.There are many beautiful plants in it.The plants have green leaves, nice flowers and fruits.Sometimes we can see insects too.This is Happy Farm.There are many farm animals in it.Peacocks, rabbits, goats and little pigs.We can feed them.What a nice school.I like my school and I like the natural world.Dear children, love your school, love the natural world.In today's class, how many stars can you get?Think about it.Congratulations, you've done a good job.So much for today.I hope you enjoy my class.Goodbye, boys and girls.Children, this semester's English class is over.In the next class, there will be a self-organized study and guidance.
